voices.name: l00
voices.text: Taking care of everyone else, <#0.2#> are you running on empty?
voices.caption: Taking care of everyone else, are you running on empty?

voices.name: l01
voices.text: Picture Aquarius. <#0.2#> The water bearer, pouring water onto the world.
voices.caption: Picture Aquarius. The water bearer, pouring water onto the world.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: But <#0.3#> if the vessel is empty, <#0.2#> there's nothing left to pour.
voices.caption: But if the vessel is empty, there's nothing left to pour.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: Loving yourself isn't selfish. <#0.2#> It's filling your own vessel first.
voices.caption: Loving yourself isn't selfish. It's filling your own vessel first.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: Because only then can your love overflow, <#0.2#> and reach the world.
voices.caption: Because only then can your love overflow, and reach the world.
